title: The Absent student
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：absent　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 absent 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the builder wrote of ① an absent student in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more absent than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the absent ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most absent student anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1973 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too absent to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the absent ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an absent look in her eyes, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as absent as the look in her eyes they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was absent or not, and he said so.

By 1986 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something absent, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite absent; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the absent ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1989, with great care, she wrote of another absent student in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed  more absent than anybody had expected.  The most absent look in her eyes in the whole site, she said in 1991, was the one she could never quite name; the absent ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 缺席（前置定语 an absent student：1979 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件缺席的学生）
B. adj. 缺席／出神（比较级 more absent than：文中两处，一处比学生，一处比预想）
C. adj. 缺席／出神（最高级 the most absent：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 缺席（表语 too absent to do：母亲觉得它太缺席，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 出神（前置定语 an absent look in her eyes：叔叔把整件事称作一桩出神的眼神）
F. adj. 出神（同级比较 as absent as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩出神的眼神相比）
G. adj. 出神（后置定语 something absent：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 出神（受程度副词修饰 quite absent：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: an absent look in her eyes

answers.why: absent 意为“缺席”，1979 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件缺席的学生”，此处作前置定语 an absent student。
absent 意为“缺席”，此处用比较级 more absent than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
absent 意为“缺席”，施工图上 十月 那行字说它是工地里最缺席的一件，故用最高级 the most absent student。
absent 意为“缺席”，母亲认为这件东西“太缺席了，谁也用不上”，too absent to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
absent 意为“出神”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩出神的眼神”，此处作前置定语 an absent look in her eyes。
absent 意为“出神”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩出神的眼神一样出神”，同级比较用 as absent as。
absent 意为“出神”，施工图上那半行字要的是“出神的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something absent。
absent 意为“出神”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当出神”，quite 修饰原级 absent。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件缺席的学生。（an absent student）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更缺席。（more absent than …）
母亲觉得它太缺席，谁也用不上。（too absent to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩出神的眼神。（an absent look in her eyes）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩出神的眼神一样出神。（as absent as …）
到了 1986 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件出神的东西。（something absent）
answers: In 1979 the builder wrote of an absent student in the plan.
Everybody said it was more absent than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too absent to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an absent look in her eyes.
He said nobody would call it as absent as the look in her eyes they had once had.
By 1986 the plan asked for nothing but something absent.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 absent 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the builder wrote of an absent student in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most absent student in the site, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too absent to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an absent look in her eyes, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite absent, and everybody laughed.
The absent ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
